mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_fixed_asset_category (book_id,code,name,years,create_time,update_time) SELECT #{bookId},code,`name`,years,NOW(),NOW() from book_fixed_asset_category_model;
mapper.select:
select bgac.category_id,bgac.book_id,bgac.code,bgac.name,bgac.years, bgac.create_time,bgac.update_time,bgac.remark from book_fixed_asset_category bgac where bgac.del_flag = 0
and bgac.book_id = #{bookId}
and bgac.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
order by bgac.create_time
mapper.update: UPDATE book_fixed_asset_category SET fixed_asset_subject_code = #{subjectCode} where fixed_asset_subject_code = #{fatherSubjectCode} and book_id = #{bookId};
UPDATE book_fixed_asset_category SET depreciation_subject_code = #{subjectCode} where depreciation_subject_code = #{fatherSubjectCode} and book_id = #{bookId};
